title: pi pipeline
description: Editor autocomplete only — the runtime validation lives in parsers/yaml.ts and core/validate.ts. See docs/syntax-reference.md for the authoritative surface.

name.description: Pipeline name (defaults to the file name)

cwd.description: Working directory; relative paths resolve against the invocation cwd

runsDir.description: Override where run logs are written

timeoutMs.description: Reserved; day one honored only as a CLI/tool argument (run_pipeline({ timeoutMs }) or /pipeline --timeout)

failFast.description: Abort outstanding siblings on the first failure

node.description: A composer OR a step. Step knobs are sibling keys — never nested inside shell:/llm:.

id.description: Explicit id; required to reference this step from when: / ${steps.…}. Ids matching /^s\d+$/ collide with the auto-id namespace and are rejected.

timeoutMs.description: SIGTERM the step after N ms; SIGKILL after abortGraceMs (default 2000).

continueOnError.description: On failure, sequence: keeps walking. Run status may become 'partial'.

when.description: Gating expression: success/failure/skipped/always/never/contains/equals/matches, && || ! ( ). No arithmetic, no user-defined helpers.

outputVar.description: Capture the primary output at steps.<id>.vars.<name>. For shell that's the stdout tail; for llm it's the final assistant text.

loop.description: Repeat body until (or while) an expression evaluates true/false. Body is a single node — wrap in sequence: for multiple.

id.description: Explicit loop id. Required to reach specific iterations from outside (steps.<id>.<N>.<bodyStepId>.<field>) or via ${loops.<id>.…} from a nested loop.

minIterations.description: Don't evaluate the stop condition until this many iterations have completed. Default 0.

until.description: Stop expression — same grammar as when:. Loop stops when this becomes true. Mutually exclusive with while:.

while.description: Stop expression — same grammar as when:. Loop stops when this becomes false (do/while semantics). Mutually exclusive with until:.

onMaxIterations.description: What to do when the cap is hit without the condition firing.

body.description: A single node (composer or step). Use sequence: to run multiple steps per iteration.

oneOf.description: Run via /bin/sh -c (pipes, globs, redirection work). Values from ${…} are substituted before the shell sees them — beware quoting.
Direct execvp; no shell involved. Safe for ${…} values with metacharacters.
Runs one isolated agent turn in a fresh sub-pi. Exactly one of skill/command/prompt/promptFile is required.

command.description: Runs a pi-registered slash command as `/<name> <args>` in a fresh sub-pi.

prompt.description: Verbatim prompt text. If `args` is also set, it is appended after a blank line.

promptFile.description: Path to a .md/.txt prompt template read at plan time. Relative paths resolve against the pipeline file. The sha256 is recorded in step.json/plan.json.

args.description: Appended to /skill:… or /<command>… invocations, or joined onto `prompt` with a blank line.

reasoning.description: Sugar: appended to `model` as :<level> unless `model` already carries a ':'.

appendSystemPrompt.description: Text appended to the sub-pi system prompt. Hashed as sha256:… in step_start/step_end so secrets don't leak into logs.

mode.description: oneshot runs `pi --mode json -p --no-session`. rpc runs `pi --mode rpc` and blocks the step until a /pipeline:chat pane calls finalize().

nonInteractiveFallback.description: Only meaningful with mode: rpc. `error` hard-fails when no UI is attached; `oneshot` degrades to a plain oneshot turn.
